column3: Primary button — solid primary-red, square, geometric sans
column4: padding: 14px 28px; background: var(--bg-red); color: var(--bg-ink); border: none; border-radius: 0; font-family: var(--bg-sans); font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em;
column5: ☐ AA contrast (red passes black-fg) ☐ no rounded corners ☐ uppercase + tracking ☐ visible focus ring ☐ 44x44 touch min

column3: Secondary — primary-blue ground
column4: padding: 14px 28px; background: var(--bg-blue); color: var(--bg-cream); border: none; border-radius: 0; font-family: var(--bg-sans); font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase;
column5: ☐ AA contrast blue/cream ☐ no rounded corners ☐ uppercase

column3: Circular action button — yellow primary
column4: width: 56px; height: 56px; background: var(--bg-yellow); color: var(--bg-ink); border: none; border-radius: 50%; font-family: var(--bg-sans); font-weight: 700; display: grid; place-items: center;
column5: ☐ AA contrast yellow/ink ☐ perfect circle ☐ accessible label via aria

column3: Geometric shape — pure circle, primary colour
column4: width: 120px; height: 120px; background: var(--bg-red); border-radius: 50%; aspect-ratio: 1;
column5: ☐ pure 1:1 aspect ☐ flat colour (no gradient) ☐ aria-hidden if decorative

column3: Geometric shape — pure square, primary colour
column4: width: 120px; height: 120px; background: var(--bg-blue); border-radius: 0; aspect-ratio: 1;
column5: ☐ pure 1:1 aspect ☐ flat colour (no gradient) ☐ no border-radius

column3: Geometric shape — equilateral triangle via clip-path
column4: width: 120px; height: 104px; background: var(--bg-yellow); clip-path: polygon(50% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%);
column5: ☐ flat colour ☐ aria-hidden if decorative ☐ accessible alt if meaningful

column3: Page ground — warm cream, never pure white
column4: background: var(--bg-cream); color: var(--bg-ink);
column5: ☐ ground not #fff ☐ AA contrast body ☐ warm undertone

column3: Display headline — geometric sans, ALL CAPS, restrained
column4: font-family: var(--bg-sans); font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 5rem); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.0; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--bg-ink);
column5: ☐ uppercase + slight tracking ☐ line-height 0.95-1.05 ☐ AA contrast ☐ geometric sans loaded

column3: Top nav — primary-colour block on left, links right
column4: display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 16px 32px; background: var(--bg-cream); border-bottom: 4px solid var(--bg-ink);
column5: ☐ semantic <nav> ☐ thick rule (4px) ☐ skip-link ☐ aria-current

column3: Feature card — flat primary-colour block, geometric layout
column4: padding: 32px; background: var(--bg-cream); border: 3px solid var(--bg-ink); border-radius: 0;
column5: ☐ no rounded corners ☐ no soft shadow ☐ thick border (3px) ☐ flat ground

column3: Hero — composition of primary shapes, asymmetric grid
column4: display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 64px; padding-block: 96px 80px; align-items: center;
column5: ☐ asymmetric composition ☐ primary triad max 3 colours visible ☐ no decorative gradient ☐ single CTA

column3: Text input — thick ink border, square, geometric sans
column4: padding: 12px 16px; background: var(--bg-cream); color: var(--bg-ink); font-family: var(--bg-sans); font-size: 16px; border: 2px solid var(--bg-ink); border-radius: 0;
column5: ☐ font-size ≥16px iOS ☐ focus shifts border to primary colour ☐ no rounded corners ☐ AA contrast

column3: Status badge — primary-colour fill, square
column4: display: inline-flex; padding: 4px 10px; background: var(--bg-yellow); color: var(--bg-ink); font-family: var(--bg-sans); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; border-radius: 0;
column5: ☐ no pill rounding ☐ AA contrast yellow/ink ☐ semantic colour and text

column3: Section divider — thick primary-colour rule
column4: height: 4px; background: var(--bg-ink); margin-block: 64px; border-radius: 0;
column5: ☐ semantic <hr> ☐ thick (4px) ☐ no gradient

column3: Geometric icon — primary-shape based, flat
column4: width: 32px; height: 32px; background: var(--bg-red); border-radius: 50%;
column5: ☐ flat colour (no gradient) ☐ aria-hidden if decorative ☐ AA contrast

column3: Modal — thick-bordered card, primary accent
column4: padding: 40px; background: var(--bg-cream); border: 4px solid var(--bg-ink); border-radius: 0; max-width: 520px;
column5: ☐ focus-trap ☐ ESC closes ☐ no rounded corners ☐ AA contrast

column3: Footer — primary-colour block, thick top rule
column4: padding-block: 56px 40px; background: var(--bg-cream); border-top: 4px solid var(--bg-ink); font-family: var(--bg-sans);
column5: ☐ semantic <footer> ☐ thick rule ☐ multi-column responsive

column3: Vertical list — geometric bullets (squares), uppercase items
column4: display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; list-style: square; font-family: var(--bg-sans); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.03em;
column5: ☐ semantic <ul>/<li> ☐ uppercase items ☐ AA contrast

column3: Focus ring — primary-blue outline
column4: outline: 3px solid var(--bg-blue); outline-offset: 2px;
column5: ☐ visible on all interactive ☐ AA contrast ☐ thick (3px) ☐ no soft glow
